rationale: config.json declares a required one-source-cycle (10 ns) event on event_in, launched on src_clk. The destination samples every 14 ns, so a permitted assertion can fall entirely between dst_clk edges and be missed. The sticky event_seen cannot recover an event that was never sampled.
caveats: CDC-013(c) applies: a required assertion shorter than one sampling interval gives WARNING Established. The contract path, a full synchroniser and the observable consumer are all present.
The sticky event_seen also cannot meet 'exactly once' for repeated events, but the sampling loss alone is enough.

author_reading.title: Short required primary event can be missed
author_reading.rationale: One-cycle asynchronous event is required to be delivered exactly once; there is no source handshake or stretch guarantee.
limitations: Structural attribution is a proposal for independent adjudication, not analyzer outcome.
Physical timing and metastability requirements remain external.

labels.rationale: Required 10 ns assertion is shorter than the 14 ns sampler interval and may be entirely missed.
caveats: Sticky event_seen also cannot count distinct deliveries; sampling loss alone suffices. config.json supplies required source_cycles contract.

labels.rationale: Required 10 ns event can fit entirely between 14 ns destination edges. Sticky evidence cannot recover an event never sampled.
labels.caveats: Sticky event_seen also cannot count repeated events; config establishes sampling-loss defect independently. Raw rst_n release is not locally synchronized or bounded by a release contract; RDC-003 remains a whole-IP closure confounder. Output consumer timing is not specified. Physical closure is excluded.
